top_choice_rationale: P001 awards targeted protein degradation to Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli: Crews and Deshaies conceived and first demonstrated induced-proximity, catalytic E3-ligase-mediated destruction, and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex cooperativity made it a reproducible molecular-design discipline. The citation is scoped to designed small molecules bringing ligases and targets together, so names and words match. The mechanism is independently confirmed; the unapproved clinical payoff is a timing risk, not a doubt about the science. P002 (Handa in place of Ciulli) covers the glue strand but pulls the citation toward two achievements, so it ranks second. P003 and P004 keep only the Crews-Deshaies core and add a second part (Cullis lipid nanoparticles, or Shokat KRAS) that is weaker in attribution or fit; any award on this topic still ranks above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only a loose field overlap in peptide/biomolecular design and nanoparticle biosensing, with no link to the proposed laureates
